blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The new fertility-survey estimates expressly give mixed support to the prior model: predicted attendance and age effects coexist with a contrasting sex difference. Jewish-population estimates broadly support the model. The final general statement about model usefulness is not an unambiguous whole-replication verdict; the original study comparison is somewhat indirect.

luna_triage.reason: The 1979 paper explicitly presents new estimates specified to reproduce the equations in Azzi and Ehrenberg (1975), cites their tables 5 and 6, and reports mixed empirical support. Shipped row 2254 is Long and Settle (1977), a separate prior follow-up discussed in the opening, not the work whose equations and findings the current paper re-estimates. The listed adjudication file is absent; supplied coding record independently states the exact cited identity and comparison.
